# SoundEffect

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- **Not creatable**: it cannot be created with `Instance.new`
- **Abstract**: it cannot be created; other classes inherit from it

The base class of audio effects, which process a sound before it reaches the speakers. Parented to a `Sound`, an effect processes that sound. Parented to an `AudioGroup`, it processes everything in the group, mixed together. Several effects under one parent are applied in order of `Priority`.

An effect changes only what is heard: nothing a script reads changes, and a sound lasts as long with an effect as without. An effect on a `Sound` stops when the sound stops. An effect on an `AudioGroup` keeps ringing after its sounds stop, which is what a reverb needs.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Enabled` | `boolean` | `true` | read/write | Whether the effect is applied. |
| `Priority` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The order of the effect among the effects under one parent: lower values are applied first, and equal values are applied in the order the effects were created. |
